lines:
Responsibilities: Opens or creates an opt-in portable repository only beneath a trusted-core-resolved project root; negotiates reader/writer compatibility; and catalogs immutable Chat/session, branch-lineage, frozen portable snapshot, and provenance manifests without treating discovery as activation.
Owned files/records and identities: repository.json contains PortableRepositoryManifestV1 and FormatVersionV1(family, major, minor, requiredFeatures, hashAlgorithm); sessions/<SessionId>/session.json contains PortableSessionManifestV1; snapshots/sha256/<digest>.json contains PortableFrozenSnapshotV1; branches/<BranchId>/branch.json contains immutable BranchManifestV1 and ParentLineageV1. ChatId, RunId, and SessionId are the same opaque stable identifier; BranchId is opaque and never time-ordered. All content addresses use the explicit sha256:<lowercase-hex> form. Parent lineage names the source SessionId, BranchId, checkpoint hash, and segment/head-record hash.
Ports/DTOs: exposes PortableCatalogPort(OpenRepository, CreateSession, CreateChildBranch, ReadSession, ReadBranch, ReadFrozenSnapshot, EnumerateBranches, NegotiateFormat) to trusted-core coordinators and internal validators. Creation requires a resolved PortableProject binding and expected absence; reads return immutable DTOs plus a CompatibilityVerdictV1.
Atomicity, conflicts, and degradation: manifests and snapshots are canonicalized, hashed, create-new written through a same-directory temporary file, fsynced, atomically renamed, and directory-fsynced. An existing identical object is idempotent; an ID collision with different bytes fails closed. Unknown major versions or required features are inspect-only; compatible minor unknown fields are retained byte-semantically. No migration rewrites published objects.
Portability, security, and NFRs: deterministic UTF-8 paths and records, bounded/cancellable enumeration, case-collision detection, and Windows/Linux/macOS fixtures. The catalog contains logical capability requirements and redacted provenance only—never credential values, inherited approvals, machine-local authority, debug capture, or executable plugin code.
Non-responsibilities: no semantic event append, branch-head advance, capability rebinding decision, authority grant, projection indexing, Git staging/commit/push, or timestamp-derived ordering.

data.name: Portable Session Manifest Catalog & Format Negotiator
data.technology: Rust catalog service over schema-versioned canonical JSON and content-addressed snapshots
